source.editorial_authority: The frozen DOCX is the editorial master; this SBL is a deterministic production derivative.

authority_exclusions: Nyas and Zora are alternate names for the same world; Nyssarian is the adjective or singular identity and Nyssarians is the plural people name.
Visible Nyssarian writing uses Nyssarian script; English is reserved for reader-facing speech or translation and approved Earth-built time-machine displays.
The Air Force hook insignia is service-specific and must not be reused for ground forces, artillery, flags, or cannon markings.
The artillery insignia is the approved hook-derived diagonal-line design and remains distinct from the Air Force and ground-force emblems.
MF-51 is the canonical aircraft designation; MF-262 is superseded and excluded.
The deleted Midori-Academy-Uniform-Production-Sheet.png is excluded from Chapter 16 authority.
Temple of Light and Academy assets are not interchangeable; use the Temple-specific environment, library, archives, and office references where mapped.
